changelog:
# ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol on ESP32C3 devices
* Implemented Wi-Fi provisioning using esp-idf framework
* Enhanced device discovery for improved connectivity

# 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with repeated device restarts due to Wi-Fi disconnection
* Resolved bug causing incorrect reporting of device battery levels
* Corrected error in handling of incoming MQTT messages

# 🔐 Security
* Identified and documented one potential secret in the codebase
* Confirmed zero critical CVEs affecting the current release
* Noted low security score of 0/10, indicating need for improvement

# ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage to 43.9%, reducing memory consumption
* Identified potential saving of 100 KB in flash memory
* Improved device boot time by optimizing initialization routines

# 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated four new tests to improve code coverage
* Applied zero AI patches, indicating no automated code changes
* Reviewed code for potential issues, but no major problems found

# ✅ Quality Gates
* Confirmed successful build of the firmware release
* Verified that all tests passed without errors
* Reviewed key metrics, including security score and flash usage

# ⚠️ Known Issues
* Low security score indicates potential vulnerabilities
* Presence of one secret in the codebase is a concern
* No patches applied in this release, which may be a issue

# 🔜 Next Release
* Plan to address low security score and remove secret from codebase
* Investigate and apply necessary patches to improve stability
* Continue to optimize performance and reduce flash usage
